subject: container port
ranking_by: containers handled in 2024, in twenty-foot units (TEU)
title: The 5 Busiest Container Ports on Earth, Ranked (4 Are in One Country)

scenes.text: The five busiest ports on Earth. Four of them are in one country.
Number five: Qingdao. About thirty-one million container loads in one year.
scenes.label: Qingdao · 30.9M TEU

scenes.text: Number four: Shenzhen. Thirty-three million, right next door to Hong Kong.
scenes.label: Shenzhen · 33.4M TEU

scenes.text: Number three: Ningbo-Zhoushan. Thirty-nine million, and it's catching up with number two fast.
scenes.label: Ningbo-Zhoushan · 39.3M TEU

scenes.text: Number two: Singapore. Forty-one million, the only one outside China.
scenes.label: Singapore · 41.1M TEU

scenes.text: Number one: Shanghai. Over fifty-one million. That's more than one and a half container loads every second, all year.
scenes.label: Shanghai · 51.5M TEU

description:
Four of the world's five busiest container ports are in China.
In 2024 Shanghai handled about 51.5 million twenty-foot container units, Singapore 41.1 million, Ningbo-Zhoushan 39.3 million, Shenzhen 33.4 million and Qingdao 30.9 million.
Which port would you have guessed at number one?
first_comment: In 2025 Shanghai went past 55 million, and Ningbo-Zhoushan finished less than a million behind Singapore. Will Singapore lose number two? What should we rank next?
